ai.headline: Pinterest updates terms, adds commercial content guidelines and arbitration changes
ai.summary: Pinterest's updated Terms of Service take effect April 30, 2025. Key changes: your interests can now be used to show you content and ads on and off Pinterest (not just on it), sponsored or commercial posts must follow a new Commercial and Branded Content Guidelines document, and the arbitration section now lets arbitrators issue any remedy allowed by law and decide disputes about arbitrability. The EEA-consumer carve-outs also now cover Switzerland, and Pinterest removed the statement that the service is free.
